name: Mento Philippine Peso
oneLiner: PHPm is Mento's Philippine peso stablecoin on Celo, minted CDP-style against USDm collateral (Mento V3, a Liquity v2 fork).
collateral: Mento V3 Liquity-v2-style CDPs collateralized by USDm; USDm in turn is backed by the diversified Mento Reserve mix (sUSDS, CELO, EURC, USDC, USDT, axlEUROC, stETH, and smaller positions exposed via the Mento reserve dashboard).
pegMechanism: Mento V3 oracle-priced FX stablecoin minted by depositing USDm as CDP collateral and borrowing PHPm against it; user-set interest rates, Stability Pool liquidations, and Liquity-style redemptions support the PHPm peg, with circuit breakers and Mento reserve transparency on the upstream USDm leg.

oracleRisk.summary: Mento V3 routes rates through SortedOracles and OracleAdapter, while BreakerBox rejects stale, out-of-bounds, or off-hours feeds before swaps/CDP routes use them.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: PHPm inherits upstream freeze exposure because the Mento reserve mix includes tracked freezable stablecoins such as USDC, USDT, and EURC.

mintAuthority.summary: PHPm is minted CDP-style on Celo via immutable BorrowerOperations; the token owner is the Mento Timelock (2-day delay) whose sole proposer is the veMENTO DAO Governor.

controls.label: Mento BorrowerOperations (immutable CDP minter)
controls.capDescription: PHPm mints only against USDm CDP collateral; BorrowerOperations has no owner() and no EIP-1967 proxy slot — immutable.
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69291577, BorrowerOperations 0x8ec9A81871F816F1EF007a82293703057A943B8A: 46358-byte code, owner() empty, EIP-1967 impl and admin slots zero — immutable, no upgrade path.

controls.label: Mento Timelock (PHPm token owner)
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69291577, PHPm owner() = 0x890DB8A597940165901372Dd7DB61C9f246e2147; getMinDelay() = 172800; hasRole(PROPOSER_ROLE, MentoGovernor 0x47036...) = true; hasRole(EXECUTOR_ROLE, 0x0) = true (open executor).

review.evidence: At Celo block 69291577: PHPm owner() = Mento Timelock 0x890DB...; getMinDelay() = 172800s; MentoGovernor is sole PROPOSER; BorrowerOperations confirmed immutable. All addressable mint surfaces confirmed.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: PHPm has a single Celo deployment in the reviewed metadata and Celo's local-stablecoin docs list PHPm as a Mento stablecoin on Celo. No material bridge route is resolved for this row.

reserveReview.rationale: Mento documents every V3 FX CDP instance as an independent Liquity-style system that uses USDm as its sole collateral asset. The configured on-chain broker pool also identifies USDm as the direct counterasset, so the reserve-derived dependency is exactly 100% Mento Dollar.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Documented single-collateral Mento V3 FX CDP architecture
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unidentified direct stablecoin dependency remains in the documented USDm-only CDP path; USDm's reserve look-through is reviewed on the upstream asset.
